sections.title: 🎯 What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Sorting arrays is like organizing your closet - it makes everything easier to find! Let's learn how to arrange numbers or words in order.

• How to sort arrays in ascending/descending order
• Built-in Java sorting methods
• How sorting works behind the scenes

sections.title: 💡 Concept Explanation
sections.content:
Imagine you have a messy pile of numbered cards. Sorting is like arranging them from smallest to largest number.

• Sorting puts elements in a specific order (numbers: 1,2,3... or words: A,B,C...)
• Java has built-in tools to sort arrays automatically
• You can sort numbers, strings, or even custom objects

Think of it like organizing your music playlist by song title or your contacts by name - it makes everything more useful!

sections.title: 📊 Visual Simulation
sections.content: Step-by-step visualization of how Sorting Arrays works:

steps.title: Unsorted Array
steps.description: We start with a messy array of numbers: [5, 2, 9, 1, 5]

steps.title: Sorting Process
steps.description: Java compares and swaps elements until they're in order. Like sorting playing cards in your hand!

steps.title: Sorted Result
steps.description: Now the array is neatly organized: [1, 2, 5, 5, 9]

sections.title: ⚡ Key Points
points: ✓ Use `Arrays.sort()` for simple sorting in Java
✓ Works with numbers, strings, and custom objects
✓ Makes searching and organizing data much easier
✓ Sorting is a fundamental computer science concept

sections.title: 🔥 Tips & Mistakes
dos: For descending order, sort then reverse
Remember arrays are sorted in-place (original changes)
donts: Don't try to sort mixed types (numbers + strings)
Don't assume the original array stays unchanged
sections.protip: For custom objects, implement the `Comparable` interface to define your own sorting rules!

sections.title: 🌍 Real World Use
sections.content: Where is Sorting Arrays used in real apps?

examples.how: Sort products by price, rating, or popularity to help customers find what they want
Sort songs alphabetically or by play count to create playlists
Sort player scores to show who's at the top of the game

problem.description: Write a program that takes 5 names from the user, stores them in an array, and then displays them in alphabetical order.
hints: Use a loop to get input for each name
problem.explanation: We collect 5 names, use `Arrays.sort()` to sort them alphabetically, then display the sorted array. Easy peasy!

sections.title: 📝 Summary
points: 📌 Sorting organizes array elements in order (numbers or words)
📌 `Arrays.sort()` is your best friend for quick sorting
📌 Practice sorting different types of data
📌 Ready to learn about searching sorted arrays next!
